stages: Channel reporting — ad-spend exports + order exports → spreadsheet reconciliation by date/channel → descriptive spend and sales report.
Joined attribution reporting — ad clicks/UTMs + consented sessions + orders → connector ingestion, deduplication and identity rules → attributable conversions with unmatched orders shown.
Attribution-model comparison — joined touchpoints + orders → explicit attribution windows/models → compare credited revenue and acquisition cost. Attribution is not causal lift.

Incrementality analysis — valid experiment or holdout data + campaign exposure + outcomes → experiment analysis with uncertainty → evidence for incremental contribution. Observational data alone is insufficient.
Budget pacing — campaign budgets + current spend → scheduled aggregation and rules → under/overspend alerts.
Performance diagnosis — campaign spend + orders + product margins → joined metrics and anomaly analysis → investigate changes in acquisition efficiency.
Budget simulation — historical spend/outcomes + seasonality + business constraints → validated response models and explicit assumptions → compare allocation scenarios, not guaranteed ROAS.
Reviewed budget recommendations — scenarios + stock/margin constraints → explainable recommendation and approval queue → marketer approves a supported change.
Stock reporting — SKU/location stock + receipts + sales + returns → spreadsheet or batch reconciliation → stock-on-hand report.
Inventory visibility — authorised inventory/WMS feeds + sales feeds → connector ingestion and shared SKU/location IDs → stock movement and availability dashboard.
Inventory-performance analysis — stock history + sales + returns → turnover, sell-through and stock-cover calculations using agreed definitions → identify slow and fast movement.
Stock-exception diagnosis — stock history + demand + lead times → exception rules and analytical joins → identify stockout, ageing-stock and excess-stock drivers.
Demand forecasting — relevant SKU/location history + promotions + availability → validated forecasting models with uncertainty → demand estimates that account for stockout-censored sales.
Safety-stock planning — forecast uncertainty + lead-time variability + service goals → buffer scenarios → compare stock protection and working-capital trade-offs.
Reorder planning — demand estimates + available/open-order stock + lead times + minimum order quantities → constrained model → compare order quantities and timing.
Reviewed replenishment — proposed orders + cash/service-level constraints → human approval and audit workflow → approved plan; purchase-order execution requires a supported API.
Outcome monitoring — actual demand + deliveries + stock outcomes → forecast-error and inventory-performance tracking → revise models and replenishment rules.
Cohort reporting — orders + consented customer identifiers → cohort aggregation → observed repeat-purchase rate and time to second order.
Lifecycle diagnosis — order cohorts + CRM engagement + cancellation/return signals → governed joins and segment comparisons → identify where repeat purchasing weakens.
Retention prediction — sufficient historical behaviour and outcomes → validated churn/next-purchase models → risk estimates with uncertainty; not assumed available from an LLM alone.
Intervention experiments — eligible consented segments + diagnostic or predictive outputs + campaign rules → reviewed audience proposals and controlled tests → assess retention interventions.
Product reporting — orders + variants + refunds → product-level aggregation → best/worst sellers by units, revenue and returns.
Conversion diagnosis — product/session/cart events + orders + availability → funnel and stock-aware analysis → identify where product journeys lose demand.
Basket and assortment analysis — baskets + margins + inventory + product attributes → co-purchase and catalogue analysis → bundle or range hypotheses.
Merchandising simulation — historical outcomes + proposed range/price changes + explicit assumptions → scenario models → compare possible margin and demand effects.
Reviewed experiments — scenario hypotheses + business constraints → experiment design and approved publishing workflow → measure actual results.
Revenue reporting — orders + refunds → consistent aggregation → net sales by period, product and channel.
Contribution calculation — sales + product costs + ad spend + fulfilment/payment fees → reconciled cost joins and agreed definitions → contribution views with missing costs flagged.
Profitability diagnosis — contribution data + channels + product mix → variance analysis → explain changes in observed profitability without inventing costs.
Customer payback analysis — acquisition cost + observed cohort contribution → cohort comparison with explicit cost coverage → assess payback without assuming future lifetime value.
Cash and margin scenarios — demand assumptions + unit economics + inventory commitments → finance-reviewed scenario model → compare consequences; estimates are not booked results.
